name: Klein Moretti
title: The Querent
bio: A history graduate of Tingen University who woke at his own desk on a crimson moon night with a revolver by his hand and no memory of firing it — and who is quietly certain he did not.

name: Dunn Smith
title: Captain of the Nighthawks
bio: Runs the Tingen team out of Blackthorn Security Company. Forgets names, dates and where he left his hat, and has never once forgotten a Sealed Artifact's number.

name: Rozanne Bansi
title: Blackthorn's front desk
bio: Books the appointments, keeps the ledgers, and knows exactly which of the company's clients are clients.

name: Leonard Mitchell
title: Nighthawk
bio: Handsome, idle, and the fastest man on the team to notice a thing nobody wanted noticed. Owes everyone in the office money.

name: Old Neil
title: Nighthawk
bio: Was a scholar before he was this. Explains the theory whether or not anybody asked, which is how most of the team learned any.

name: Sergeant Gehrman
title: Tingen police
bio: Wrote up your death as a suicide, and has been sleeping badly since he did.

name: Naya Gerard
title: Found him
bio: Was at the gathering, went back on the Tuesday because nobody had seen him, and has not been able to describe the door properly to anyone since.

name: Kohler Fels
title: Also at the gathering
bio: Talks first and fastest, which in a room of frightened people passes for calm. Says he went home at nine.

name: Melissa Moretti
title: Your sister
bio: Technical school, top of her year, and doing sums about this household she should not have to be doing.

name: Mr. Aldous
title: Collector
bio: Buys things the Church would burn, pays in cash, and has never told anybody who he buys them for.

name: Welch Tapman
title: Deceased
bio: University acquaintance with a taste for the occult as a party trick. It was his gathering, his rooms, and his idea to read the thing aloud.

name: Sil Mowbray
title: Tussock ferry hand
bio: Works the night crossing, sees who goes over and when, and will tell you for the price of a drink he will not stop at one of.

name: Benson Moretti
title: Your brother
bio: Clerk at a shipping office and, since your father died, the reason this family still eats. He is the one who opened the door and found you.
